name: cfl-oracle
description: Register entry D9 (spec/V0.8-DECISIONS.md, #139): the oracle upper bound on any adaptive or conditional chroma-from-luma form, scored on tune before any deployable arm is built. At each code 0-4 the tier's shipped arm comes first and is the incumbent, followed by three free CfL arms that differ only in the gain's precision and clamp: cfl_bits=5 cfl_range=0.5 (D7's free arm, cfl.json), cfl_bits=8 cfl_range=0.25 and cfl_bits=10 cfl_range=1.0 (a near-exact least-squares gain). The gains are free: the 2*cfl_bits field is added on top of the tier's bytes, so a free arm's hash is 1-3 bytes longer than its tier, and no expectBytes is held. The bound at code k is the mean over images of the lowest ΔE00 among that tier's four arms, against the shipped arm's mean (mise run stratify cfl-oracle --cfl-oracle; mise run register-verdict D9). Corpus all with realOnly: the photographic, alpha and graphics tune images, so every holdout3 stratum the tune split holds is in one run, with D1's white-black-grey backdrops and alpha fidelity. Cross-tier rows of the printed tables are at different byte counts and are not read.
